original.target_description: Experiment 2: correct-response mean RT for auditory letter flankers across perceptual-congruent, response-congruent, and incongruent conditions; one-way repeated-measures congruency ANOVA. Located original congruency main effect; the replication modality-interaction test cannot match an original modality interaction because original Experiment 2 used auditory flankers only.

n.location: Experiment 2, Method, Participants; Results and discussion ANOVA df (2,70)
n.quote: A fresh sample of 36 participants was recruited (24 females and 12 males, mean age 24.83 years). Two participants were replaced because they made more than 10% errors.
n.sample_role: Participants retained for Experiment 2 repeated-measures ANOVA; final sample supported by F(2,70).
n.exclusions: Two participants with more than 10% errors were replaced. Incorrect responses and RTs outside 150–1500 ms (0.05% and 0.88%) were excluded from RT analyses.

notes: Sources verified by title/reference. Original reports η² as printed; no conversion to partial eta squared. Quotes normalize HTML line breaks and superscripts. Replication wiki is the primary authors’ summary and reports the after-exclusion sample. The description includes both congruency and its interaction with modality; replication extraction selects the explicitly named modality interaction. Original Experiment 2 has auditory flankers only, so its extracted corresponding congruency test is F(2,70)=47.05; it contains no congruency × modality test. Do not treat these original and replication tests as identical.
